name: Gunn Rose
source:
| LV: 80 | Priest |

Gunn lives and works at his parents' church, using his time spent there to increase his skills as a healer. His enthusiasm for healing is often taken the wrong way, making first impressions not his best skill, but he shrugs that, and most other things, off pretty easily.

(Taken from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31456"]Lemma Soft thread[/url])
